P1.proof: Post-fix keyboard soak: 100/100, zero failures or cleanup leaks.

P1.title: Saved operation-result fields were not usable as Script API variables.
P1.proof: The runner now resolves save_as field paths; 61 unit tests and public API gap soak 100/100 pass.

P1.title: The gap soak manifest used a report name different from the runner script name.
P1.proof: Manifest corrected; 100/100 evidence now links final report.json correctly.

P1.title: Runtime/visibility/screenshot failure classification and scroll/drag focus convergence had historical reliability defects.
P1.proof: Fresh remediation 8/8 and failure injection 5/5 passed with zero cleanup failures.
